claim: AI accounted for about 15% of data centre electricity demand in 2024 in the framing used for this project.
shortLabel: AI share of data centre demand
comparisonContext: The other 80-85% represents the broader digital economy faculty and students already use: streaming, video calls, email, social media, enterprise software, and cloud services.
scopeNote: Share of data centre demand, not share of all electricity demand.
